name: @two_5_d/core-editor-pack
description: The Cardboard editor itself, shipped as an editor pack. P1 (spike) validated that pack-shipped TSX components share React with the host editor. P2 (this commit) migrates the first hand-written panel — NotesPanel — into the pack via the new `ctx.registerPanel(def)` API on `EditorPackContext`. Subsequent phases continue draining views/panels/layouts out of `apps/editor/src/views/` into here until the editor shell is bare and the core pack IS the editor.
